Hosted Inference: Cost-Fallback & Telemetry Normalization 1.2 Release Notes

Release 1.2 introduces the Cost-Fallback policy engine for hosted inference and a normalized telemetry pipeline for cost attribution. This release improves transparency for fallback events, aligns billing signals with runtime decisions, and reduces cost overcounting in multi-variant fallthrough scenarios.
Cost-Fallback engine: deterministic policy layer that chooses fallback variants based on a configurable cost threshold and fidelity constraints.
Telemetry Normalization v1: a new pipeline stage that deduplicates token-attribution events across model-variant handoffs and retries.
Per-request fallback annotations surfaced in Console and API response headers for easier auditing and customer diagnostics.
New billing hook: optional trial-mode mode that simulates invoicing changes for 30 days without affecting charges.
Updated SDKs: client-side flag to opt into fallback transparency headers (Python/Node 1.2.0+).
Runtime and billing are backward compatible. Customers using legacy billing callbacks should update their webhook consumers to accept the new 'x-redwood-fallback-reason' header. SDK upgrades are recommended to get transparent fallback headers; however, clients that do not upgrade will continue to receive previous response shapes with reduced visibility.
| Area | Change | Customer Impact | Mitigation |
|---|---|---|---|
| Serving runtime | Cost-Fallback engine enabled by default for low-tier routes | Potentially different model variants selected under peak load | See rollout controls and opt-out guide below |
| Billing & metering | Telemetry Normalization deduplicates attribution events | Near-term apparent drop in 'per-token' invoiced events on reconciliations (expected) | Billing simulator available; reconciliations will align within billing cycle |
| Console | New fallback timeline and per-request annotations | Additional UI column and export fields | Minor learning curve; docs + quickstart provided |
| SDKs | Response header additions and opt-in flags | No functional breakage, richer diagnostics | Upgrade SDK to 1.2.0+ for full experience |
1) 2026-06-30: Canary rollout on 5% hosted traffic in us-west-2.
2) 2026-07-07: Observability window review; extend to 25% if no regressions.
3) 2026-07-14: Billing reconciliation test with sandbox customers.
4) 2026-07-21: Full enablement for hosted API worldwide with migration window.
5) 2026-08-01: Billing switch: normalization applied to customer invoices (retroactive disclaimers applied for trial-mode customers).
Step 1: Review the Cost-Fallback policy defaults in Console > Routing > Fallback Policies and note any routes with custom targeting.
Step 2: For enterprise contracts with explicit variant lock requirements, open a support ticket to pin variant selection or opt-out of the Cost-Fallback engine.
Step 3: If you have downstream billing webhooks, update consumers to parse and ignore unknown headers; optionally implement handling for 'x-redwood-fallback-reason'.
Step 4: Enable Billing Simulator in Console > Billing > Simulators for a 30-day trial of normalized billing to preview impact (no real charges).
Step 5: Upgrade client SDKs to 1.2.0+ to receive fallback annotations in response headers and to toggle client-side annotation flags where necessary.
| Config | Default | Notes |
|---|---:|---|
| fallback.cost_threshold_pct | 20 | Percentage over baseline cost allowed before fallback triggers |
| fallback.fidelity_floor | medium | Minimum fidelity required for fallback target variants |
| telemetry.dedup_window_ms | 250 | Time window for de-duplicating token attribution events |
| billing.simulator.enabled | false | Admin toggle to run invoicing preview without charges |
What we collect and how to monitor:
- New emitted events: 'fallback.choice', 'fallback.eviction', 'telemetry.normalization.delta'.
- Console dashboards: 'Fallback Rate by Route', 'Normalized vs Raw Token Delta'.
- Alerts added: 'Fallback rate > 15% for 5m' (severity P2), 'Normalization delta > 10% for a billing window' (severity P3).
Action: On elevated fallback rates investigate KV-cache hit rates, variant capacity, and cost profiles. Telemetry Normalization alert indicates reconciliation variance; if triggered, contact billing-ops before making routing changes.
1) Toggle 'fallback.enabled' to false at service-level (Console or API) to stop policy-based variant selection.
2) Revert telemetry normalization by setting 'telemetry.normalization.enabled' to false in Admin feature-flags (safe for 1-hour windows).
3) If invoice anomalies occur, enable billing.simulator and run reconciliation; contact finance-ops to freeze invoice dispatch.
4) Post-mortem: collect last 72h of 'fallback.choice' and 'telemetry.normalization.delta' events and file incident per oncall runbook.
- In rare cases (multi-region failover + retry storm) deduplication may undercount attribution; SREs will apply a temporary increased dedup_window_ms.
- SDKs older than 1.1.5 will not expose new header metadata; these clients will see reduced visibility into fallback decisions.
- Customers using third-party metering proxies that rely on raw token events should use the Billing Simulator to validate before full migration.
Q: Will normalized telemetry change what I'm billed?
A: Normalized telemetry reconciles attribution to avoid double-counting across retries and handoffs; legitimate usage is preserved, but line-item distribution may shift. Use the Billing Simulator to see projected changes.

Q: Can I disable Cost-Fallback for specific routes?
A: Yes — Console supports per-route override. For contracts that require strict variant selection, contact your account team to set enforcement rules.

Q: What if normalization causes a >15% delta during initial invoices?
A: We will not auto-bill unilaterally. Billing ops will notify impacted customers during the migration window and apply manual reconciliations as needed.
- 2026-07-09: Run 72h reconciliation job for canary tenants and publish findings.
- 2026-07-18: Deliver support knowledge base article and customer comms template.
- 2026-08-05: Retrospective with stakeholders to capture improvements for 1.3.
Product owner: Aisha R. Morales (aisha.morales@redwood.ai)
Engineering lead: Marcus Li (marcus.li@redwood.ai)
SRE oncall: paged via #sre-oncall
Billing ops: billing-ops@redwood.ai
Support: support@redwood.ai
